sources.entry: VictoriaMetrics | Fast, cost-effective and scalable monitoring solution and time series database

summary.one_liner: VictoriaMetrics is a time series database and monitoring solution, offered as a single-node binary or a cluster version, that can serve as long-term storage for Prometheus.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes VictoriaMetrics as a storage and query system for time series data, optimized for workloads where old series are constantly replaced by new ones. It can act as long-term storage for Prometheus or as a drop-in replacement for Prometheus and Graphite in Grafana. It accepts data over many protocols, including Prometheus remote write, InfluxDB line protocol, Graphite, OpenTSDB, DataDog, NewRelic and OpenTelemetry. It supports PromQL and its own MetricsQL query language, and offers stream aggregation usable as a StatsD alternative. Backup and restore use instant snapshots, and it can store data on NFS-based storage such as Amazon EFS. The Enterprise edition adds features such as anomaly detection, downsampling, multiple retentions and backup automation.
use_cases: replace Prometheus or Graphite as a Grafana data source
monitor Kubernetes and APM metrics at high cardinality
collect InfluxDB, Graphite, OpenTSDB or DataDog metrics in one place
aggregate StatsD-style metrics with stream aggregation
store IoT or industrial telemetry time series
how_to_run: Download a binary release, or pull a Docker image from Docker Hub or Quay
Start the single-node binary with command-line flags
Follow the quick start guide linked in the README
notable: Single small binary with no dependencies and command-line configuration
Accepts many ingestion protocols including Prometheus remote write, InfluxDB, Graphite and OpenTelemetry
Global query view across multiple Prometheus instances and data sources
Instant snapshots for backup and restore
Open-source single-node and cluster versions under Apache License 2.0
caveats: Enterprise-only features such as anomaly detection, downsampling and multiple retentions require a paid or trial license
Commercial support is available only through a paid contact
Benchmark claims are vendor-stated and not independently verified in the README
